调用预训练模型生成序列预测

为本地应用或网页整合语法检查

复用已有浏览器登录状态开展自动化

Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Cline & Copilot. Quota-aware auto-fallback, RTK+Caveman compression saves 15-95% tokens, MCP/A2A, Desktop/PWA. Built by hundreds of contributors
items.zh: 统一接入多家模型供应商，并按额度和可用性路由请求的 AI 网关。

items.desc: Chat2DB is a free, cross-platform, local-first database client and SQL workspace for developers, DBAs, analysts, and data teams. use_cases: 管理数据库连接与执行 SQL
用配置的模型解释或生成查询
